signatures.description: A CLI verb pins in its descriptor: --json prints exactly one JSON line. Populated paths honor it (a MarshalJSON method enforces one top-level key). But the empty-ledger and absent-ledger honest-degradation branches print a human prose line (exit 0), so machine consumers parse-error on exactly the cold-start day zero usage is the report. Existing tests only pin the TEXT form on those branches (non-empty output), so prose passes CI. SOLUTION: route the degraded branches through the SAME marshal path as populated reports: when --json is set, render the zero-value object (zero reads as zero: empty maps not null, every key present) and print that single line; keep prose for the text form; reuse the existing marshal method instead of hand-building JSON. Additive tests: --json over empty AND absent storage parses as one object with every key at zero. PATTERN: a wire-shape pin must be asserted in EVERY exit-0 mode, especially the degraded ones; prose is for the text form only.
